qs.q: A surgical resident is asked about the precise anatomical location of the deep inguinal ring. Where does this structure lie in relation to the inguinal ligament?
o: Medial to the inferior epigastric vessels
Directly at the mid-inguinal pulse point
About 1.25 cm above the inguinal ligament
Just above and lateral to pubic tubercle
qs.e: The deep ring is situated about 1.25 cm above the midpoint of the inguinal ligament, just lateral to the inferior epigastric artery. The mid-inguinal point is where the femoral pulse is felt.
qs.s: Abdominal Wall Hernias: Anatomy, Types, Complications and Repair: MCQs
